name: Keeper Security
description: Keeper Security is a zero-trust and zero-knowledge platform providing password management, privileged access management, and secrets management for individuals and enterprises.
best_for: Enterprises, government agencies, and managed service providers that need unified password, privileged access, and secrets management.
features: Password management for enterprise, business, and family accounts
Privileged access management with just-in-time access and session auditing
Secrets Manager for policy-based credential and database access
AI-powered threat detection that classifies risk and terminates high-risk sessions
Dark web monitoring for personal and business breach scanning
Browser extensions for Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge
